newsitem.title: UK: "English Patient" is hot Oscars favourite.
newsitem.headline: "English Patient" is hot Oscars favourite.

text.p: British bookmakers installed the romantic desert epic "The English Patient" on Tuesday as red hot favourite to win the coveted best film Oscar at next week's Hollywood ceremony.

The film, which received 12 Oscar nominations, was made the odds on favourite at 1-6, with "Shine", the story of an Australian pianist suffering from a mental breakdown, a distant second choice at 11-2.

"This is the shortest priced favourite I can remember," said Simon Clare, spokesman for the bookmakers Ladbrokes. "We have had about 50,000 pounds ($80,000) wagered in bets. Several of them are people working within the film industry."
"Fargo" at 7-1, "Jerry Maguire" at 10-1 and "Secrets & Lies" at 25-1 are the other films nominated for best picture.
Geoffrey Rush, the fast-talking star of "Shine," was the 8-13 odds on favourite to receive the best male actor award on March 24, followed at Tom Cruise at 7-2 for his role in "Jerry Maguire".

Frances McDormand, the star of "Fargo", was also odds on at 4-9 to get the best actress award with Brenda Blethyn at 3-1) for "Secrets & Lies" and Kristin Scott Tomas on 4-1 for "The English Patient".
